verdict.reasons: The image successfully displays the required AFP drip tape carton roll with authentic branding and the correct 'Drip Irrigation Tape' caption. The scene correctly depicts a wheat crop bed with installed drip laterals, aligning perfectly with the agronomy focus and 20cm spacing article. The watermarked identity code is present. Minor imperfections include the slight blurriness of the secondary fine print on the carton and the installed drip lines appearing slightly thick relative to standard 20cm tape (which may be 2.5mm tape), but these are advisory and do not affect the core identity or coherence of the editorial illustration.
